name: Fluidless_Mining_and_Ore_Washing_AF
title: Fluidless Mining and Ore Washing by AivanF
author: AivanF
description: Ores that would normally require fluid to mine, are now mined normally, but need to be washed with corresponding fluid. Designed for use with Angel's infinite ores, RSO, Bob's and Clown's mods. Patched by AivanF for Factorio 2 support.
